items.title: Frank Foster and Bill Hughes interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Schenectady, New York, March 28, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Wait a minute, you’re not talking about John Heard?

ctx.x: Now John Heard told us that his first night on the band Basie did that and he’s going, he’s saying “what’s the tune” and one guy told him it’s number 4 and one guy told him it’s number 11. You guys wouldn’t do that, would you? Of course but he said he couldn’t read music anyway so it didn’t matter.
Wait a minute, you’re not talking about John Heard?
I think he was putting us on.
